answer: A candle is measured by the hours it burns, and the hours are counted by the watchman who lights it. Proof of ropewalk strand via tarred yarn counts the hours: a strand the ropewalker lays only after he tars a yarn he actually spun. The vine is the lighting, done by a hand that knows the wick; the wander is the guttering, when the wax runs low. To fake a night's burning a cheat needs 23 candles and 23 watchmen, and the pearl still shows no flame at all.
